author: Brenden100001
quote: Somehow Rockstar keeps pushing the bar of what a video game can achieve. This is the greatest game of 2026 and of the entire past century.

author: Brenden100001
quote: Unfortunately the game isn’t as good as Nintendo fans hyped it up to be. It’s a poor recreation with a cheap Unreal Engine 5 art style that stripped away all the soul the original N64 had in it. It’s just a simple loud reminder that the best days of Nintendo ended decades ago.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Brenden100001
quote: Metroid is a cool franchise, but this game does not succeed in giving us a cool Metroid experience. Great visuals, cool atmosphere. Terrible design choices (the desert, checkpoints, escort missions, hyper linear corridor exploration.) Terrible side companions that combines excessive handholding and bad millennial, marvel like writing. Shrines that feel like a cheap BOTW clone game. Gameplay that feels like it came out of a 20 year coma. $40 Metroid amiibo that pallwalls the ability to choose music while you're on your motorbike. To beat the game, needing to smash hours worth of crystals across a bland and lazy landscape. Praising this game out of fanboyism and brand obsession only ensures you’ll continue to get low quality games like this in the future. Nintendo was once a creative and inspiring powerhouse. Modern Nintendo needs to wake up.

author: Brenden100001
quote:
Fire everyone at Pokemon Company and shut down Game Freak. It’s getting pathetic. A new low for Pokemon, Nintendo, and those that support this. 

Cardboard flat textures, a small city map that restricts you from entering its buildings, excessive handholding, zero voice acting, and lazy button mashing combat.

They made the game artificially harder and visually worse by having your character kite around the enemy Pokémon like an absolute moron. Instead of being strategic with move sets, instead of anchoring yourself for battle, you now run around back and fourth across the arena with your dumb little Pokemon because the developers over at Game Freak were too lazy and too incompetent to code the Pokemon to behave how they should for battles.
